What if the secret of life is simpler than you think?

Kevin Trudeau shares what a great guru once told him: love everyone without exception and without condition. And remember there is only one.

He says you are not separate from anyone or anything. That idea, to him, is the secret of the universe.

It is a simple lesson about relationships that asks a lot of us.

Who in your life would change if you loved them without conditions?

#ad #love #relationships #kevintrudeau

The rich man learns from the fool. The fool won't learn from the rich man.

Kevin Trudeau shares his first principle for success: listen to people who have what you want and have been where you are.

He says rich people know they can learn from anyone. Someone who is struggling often doesn't even want advice from a person who has more.

That gap in teachability is a big part of the difference.

Who could you learn from if your pride stepped aside?

Kevin's network for money and success thinking (GIN) is in my highlights.

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Who is talking in your head, and who is listening?

Kevin Trudeau points out a strange fact. When you hear a voice in your head, one part of you talks and another part listens.

He says the mind is the one talking, while the real you is the observer. The problem, he says, is that the mind ends up controlling you.

His lessons aim to flip that, so you control the mind instead.

Do you run your thoughts, or do they run you?

#ad #mind #mindset #kevintrudeau
